mapper.select: SELECT f.*, DATE_FORMAT(f.visit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate FROM tb_footprint f INNER JOIN ( SELECT good_id, DATE(visit_time) AS visit_date, MAX(visit_time) AS max_visit_time FROM tb_footprint WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY good_id, DATE(visit_time) ) latest ON f.good_id = latest.good_id AND DATE(f.visit_time) = latest.visit_date AND f.visit_time = latest.max_visit_time WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.visit_time DESC

SELECT SUM(daily_unique_visits) AS total_unique_visits FROM ( SELECT DATE(visit_time) AS visit_date, COUNT(DISTINCT good_id) AS daily_unique_visits FROM tb_footprint tf WHERE tf.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE(visit_time) ) AS daily_visits
